title: Creation - The Beginning

questions.question: What did God create on the first day?
questions.explanation: Genesis 1:3 (ESV): "And God said, Let there be light, and there was light."

questions.question: According to Genesis 1:26, in whose image was mankind created?
options: In the image of the earth
questions.explanation: Genesis 1:26 (ESV): "Then God said, Let us make man in our image, after our likeness..."

questions.question: What phrase is repeated to emphasize God's creation was good?
options: And God saw that it was good
questions.correctAnswer: And God saw that it was good
questions.explanation: This phrase appears multiple times throughout Genesis 1 to affirm the goodness of creation.

questions.question: What did God create on day six?
questions.explanation: Genesis 1:24-27: God created land animals and then mankind on the sixth day.

questions.question: What did God do on the seventh day?
questions.explanation: Genesis 2:2 (ESV): "And on the seventh day God finished his work... and he rested."

questions.question: On which day did God create the sun, moon, and stars?
questions.explanation: Genesis 1:14-19: God made the two great lights and the stars on the fourth day.

questions.question: What did God give mankind dominion over?
options: Fish, birds, livestock, and all the earth
questions.correctAnswer: Fish, birds, livestock, and all the earth
questions.explanation: Genesis 1:26,28: God gave humans dominion over all living creatures and the earth.

questions.question: What did God create on the fifth day?
questions.explanation: Genesis 1:20-23: God created fish and birds on the fifth day.

questions.question: What did God create to separate day from night on day four?
questions.explanation: Genesis 1:14-18: God made two great lights to govern day and night.

questions.question: What command did God give to the living creatures He created?
questions.explanation: Genesis 1:22,28: God blessed them saying "Be fruitful and multiply."

questions.question: What was the state of the earth before God began creating?
questions.explanation: Genesis 1:2 (ESV): "The earth was without form and void, and darkness was over the face of the deep."

questions.question: What was hovering over the face of the waters in Genesis 1:2?
questions.explanation: Genesis 1:2 (ESV): "And the Spirit of God was hovering over the face of the waters."

questions.question: What did God call the expanse that separated the waters above from waters below?
questions.explanation: Genesis 1:8 (ESV): "And God called the expanse Heaven."

questions.question: According to Genesis 1, what food did God originally give to mankind?
questions.explanation: Genesis 1:29 (ESV): "I have given you every plant yielding seed... and every tree with seed in its fruit."

questions.question: What unique phrase in Genesis 1:26 suggests plurality within God?
options: "Let us make man in our image"
questions.correctAnswer: "Let us make man in our image"
questions.explanation: Genesis 1:26: The plural "us" and "our" is understood as a reference to the Trinity.

key_verse_text: In the beginning God created the heavens and the earth.
